stewardship.title: Your stewardship score, in plain language
stewardship.intro: The score is a 0–100 summary of how consistently and how well a project is looked after. It is not a token and cannot be bought or transferred. Every number comes from records in the platform.

componentHelp.default: A component of the score, computed from the inputs listed with it.
componentHelp.verification_continuity: How steadily independent verifiers have approved your monitoring reports. A run of approvals raises it; requests for changes and rejections lower it.
componentHelp.satellite_survival: Whether the satellite record shows the mangroves are still there compared with before the project started. A confirmed loss alert that no independent reviewer has cleared lowers it.
componentHelp.evidence_quality: How well the latest field photos passed the automatic checks: location, time window, duplicates and photo metadata.

tips.title: Getting good evidence
tips.tip1: Take the plot-centre photo standing at the plot marker, with the marker visible in the frame.
tips.tip2: Wait for GPS accuracy to settle before capturing: a photo taken with a poor fix can fall outside the boundary and fail the location check.
tips.tip3: Use the capture-nonce shown in the app for each photo, and capture within its time window.
tips.tip4: Do not edit, crop or re-save photos: the checks compare the file hash and EXIF data with what the device recorded.
tips.tip5: Photograph each plot in clear light, without a finger or strap over the lens.
tips.tip6: Submit photos for the period they belong to; late submissions are checked the same way but may miss the review window.
